Messages.Author: Robert Ekvall
Messages.Body:
This is the scenario: Cardano is at 0 blood and hunts successfully. He
then freak drives and untaps at 0 blood. Now he has to hunt but he can't
because he has already so he can't take any action right?

What if I tapped the Heidelburg castle after I untapped him and moved
blood to him? Or another of my prince/justicars made a fifth? Or he
burned his Blood tears to gain blood?

Is there a difference between the three?

Robert

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 24 Oct 1999, Robert Ekvall wrote:

> This is the scenario: Cardano is at 0 blood and hunts successfully. He
> then freak drives and untaps at 0 blood. Now he has to hunt but he can't
> because he has already so he can't take any action right?
>
> What if I tapped the Heidelburg castle after I untapped him and moved
> blood to him?

He would then have blood on him, and would not be required to hunt. Thus,
he would escape the "Must do, but prohibited from doing it" loop, and
would be free to take other actions.

> Or another of my prince/justicars made a fifth? Or he
> burned his Blood tears to gain blood?
>

As above. In each case, he then gets blood, so is not required to hunt.

--

James Coupe
